local:devcontainer-secret-file-lifecycle.title:
Doppler 3.76.0 added fallback-file caching for every mounted format.
The devcontainer design must keep fallback behavior explicit: prefer an
ephemeral `doppler run --mount` source feeding the devcontainer CLI's native
`--secrets-file` boundary, scrub `DOPPLER_TOKEN` before the container process,
and never persist a plaintext env file. This remains tracked until the broader
lifecycle-scoped secret-delivery architecture is implemented and verified.
